findings.detail: RQM+ spread was stored as 725.0 percent instead of converting 725 basis points to 7.25 percent.
TAUC Management spread was stored as 700.0 percent instead of converting 700 basis points to 7.00 percent.

rationale: The filing's Spread above Index column reports RQM+ as S+ 725 PIK and TAUC Management as S+ 700 PIK. In this notation 725 and 700 are basis points, equivalent to 7.25 and 7.00 whole-number percentages. The extracted basis_spread values 725.0 and 700.0 therefore retain basis-point magnitude and are each 100 times too large.
